d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, in a dramatic strategic shift across the Middle East and the Red Sea, Egypt has confirmed a covert military deployment inside Saudi Arabia. Speaking through recent ministerial revelations, Cairo acknowledged that its armed forces—including potential fighter jets, air-defence systems, and naval warships—have been quietly stationed in the Kingdom to support Riyadh against renewed Houthi attacks. While the deployment was rubber-stamped behind closed doors under Article 152 of Egypt's constitution, President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi's move is about far…
